By maintaining a 0.00% FPR (Clopper-Pearson exact one-sided 95% upper bound: 2.67%), it preserves the pedagogical experience without friction, while still significantly reducing the bypass rate to 46.34% compared to the 69.65% of single-layer regex filters.
